title: A Portrait for the Inheritance
premise: Ines Hartwell, a night dispatcher who has quietly catalogued two decades of the town's secrets, receives a prepaid call from a nervous client asking her to prove that a murder will not happen — a murder scheduled for the night of the Hartwell estate's inheritance reading. As she cross-references her own dispatch logs with the family's history, she realizes the killer is someone using her filing system against her, anticipating every move the police make. The victim is meant to be the estranged heir, and the murderer is the family lawyer who has been laundering the estate for years and once used Ines's own records to erase a past crime. In the end, Ines turns her archive into a trap, feeding the killer false routes through her dispatch board, and chooses love — with the heir she was hired to protect — over the duty of silence that has defined her life.
about_author: Ulyana Brightwater is the pen name of a former small-town court stenographer who spent eleven years listening to other people's confessions before writing her own stories. She lives in a converted firehouse with two cats named after cold cases.

chapters.title: The Prepaid Call
chapters.summary: Ines, on her routine night shift, takes an anonymous prepaid booking: a ride to the Hartwell estate on the exact date of the inheritance reading, with instructions to 'prove nothing happens.' POV: Ines. Emotional beat: unease — twenty years of instinct tell her this call is a confession wearing a reservation number.

chapters.title: Alphabet of Small Sins
chapters.summary: Ines digs into her private index cards and finds the caller's voice matches a man tied to a decade-old hit-and-run she helped bury in the files. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: guilt — she realizes her beloved archive may have protected a killer all along.

chapters.title: The Heir Who Came Back
chapters.summary: Ines stakes out the estate and meets Daniel Hartwell, the estranged heir, charming and defensive about why he returned. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: reluctant attraction — he is either her target's victim or her suspect, and she can't yet tell which.

chapters.title: Dispatch Log, Page One
chapters.summary: A taxi from Ines's own company ferries someone to the estate at 3 a.m.; the driver remembers nothing, but the log entry is written in notation only Ines uses. POV: alternating Ines and Detective Ruiz. Emotional beat: violation — the killer is inside her system, speaking her language.

chapters.title: Reading of the Will
chapters.summary: At the inheritance reading, lawyer Marcus Vane controls every document while family tensions detonate; Daniel is disinherited publicly. POV: Ines, attending as Vane's hired 'security consultant.' Emotional beat: dread sharpening into clarity — Vane benefits from every death but one.

chapters.title: What the File Forgot
chapters.summary: Ruiz shares the old case file; Ines spots a gap where her own card should be — someone removed it years ago using her access codes. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into resolve; she stops being an observer and starts building a trap.

chapters.title: Night Routes
chapters.summary: Ines reprograms the dispatch board with false bookings designed so only someone who knows her system perfectly would take the bait. POV: Ines, with interludes from the killer's perspective. Emotional beat: cold courage — hunter and hunted now share the same map.

chapters.title: The Trap Springs Wrong
chapters.summary: Vane anticipates her trap, frames Daniel for vandalism, and reveals he knows about Ines's buried hit-and-run card — blackmail. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: despair at its lowest point; her archive, her love, and her freedom are all hostage.

chapters.title: Three A.M., Estate Drive
chapters.summary: Climax: Ines feeds Vane one final fabricated route, luring him to the estate the night of the reading; Daniel plays his role as bait, and Ruiz waits in the dark. Vane confesses the old murder mid-act, recorded by the very dispatch line he exploited. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into triumph.

chapters.title: A Portrait for the Inheritance
chapters.summary: Resolution: Vane is arrested, the estate passes to Daniel, and Ines burns her secret index cards — except one, the first page of a new life. She takes the morning shift, and Daniel takes her to breakfast. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: quiet release — identity chosen, love kept, power finally uncorrupted.
